cases.question: Current AX-17 renal guidance in Germany?
cases.answer:

Mild renal impairment (eGFR 60-89) starting dose is 50 mg OD, maximum 100 mg/day, monitoring routine [E2]. Moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59) starting dose is 25 mg OD, maximum 50 mg/day, monitoring recheck 2-4 weeks [E1, E2, E4]. Severe renal impairment (eGFR 15-29) starting dose specialist review, maximum 25 mg/day, monitoring enhanced [E2].

cases.answer:

cases.question: Compare AE evidence in HN-204 and HN-311.
cases.answer:
In HN-204, treatment-emergent adverse events for AX-17 are nausea (12.7%), headache (14.0%), fatigue (15.3%), dizziness (16.6%), rash (17.8%), and transaminase elevation (19.1%) [E1]. Control percentages in HN-204 are nausea (6.0%), headache (6.6%), fatigue (7.2%), dizziness (7.8%), rash (8.4%), and transaminase elevation (9.0%) [E1]. Transaminase elevation is serious, while nausea, headache, fatigue, dizziness, and rash are not serious [E1]. In HN-311, treatment-emergent adverse events for AX-17 are nausea (11.8%), headache (13.0%), fatigue (14.2%), dizziness (15.4%), rash (16.6%), and transaminase elevation (17.7%) [E2]. Control percentages in HN-311 are nausea (6.0%), headache (6.6%), fatigue (7.2%), dizziness (7.8%), rash (8.4%), and transaminase elevation (9.0%) [E2]. Transaminase elevation is serious, while nausea, headache, fatigue, dizziness, and rash are not serious [E2]. For HN-204, the highest treatment % is transaminase elevation (19.1) [E4]. For HN-311, the highest treatment % is transaminase elevation (17.7) [E4]. Treatment % differences (HN-311 minus HN-204) are -1.2 points for dizziness, -1.1 points for fatigue, -1.0 points for headache, -0.9 points for nausea, -1.2 points for rash, and -1.4 points for transaminase elevation [E4]. Control % differences (HN-311 minus HN-204) are +0.0 points for all events [E4]. All treatment % differences (HN-311 minus HN-204) lie between -1.4 and -0.9 points [E4].

Sources
[E1] HN-204 · HN-204 Clinical Study v1.0 · APPROVED · effective 2025-06-12 · p.11, Table 14
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/HN-204_Clinical_Study.pdf#page=11
[E2] HN-311 · HN-311 Clinical Study v1.0 · APPROVED · effective 2026-01-18 · p.11, Table 14
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/HN-311_Clinical_Study.pdf#page=11
[E4] computed by code from [E3] (differences and highest values; not document text)

Descriptive comparison across separate studies, not a head-to-head result.
